unsupported_server_version.title: Unsupported Device Builder for {title}
unsupported_server_version.description: The Device Builder that compiles {title} reports version {server_version}, which ESPHome Git Updates does not support. Updates for {title} are paused until the Device Builder runs a supported version or this integration is updated.

unexpected_frame.title: Unexpected answer from the Device Builder for {title}
unexpected_frame.description: The Device Builder that compiles {title} sent something ESPHome Git Updates does not understand, so updates for {title} are paused. This usually means the Device Builder changed its protocol. Details: {error}

missing_ota.title: {title} cannot be updated over the air
missing_ota.description:
The YAML of {title} has no `ota:` entry with platform `esphome` or `web_server`, so ESPHome Git Updates refuses to install it. Add one, for example:

```yaml
ota:
  - platform: esphome
```

then flash {title} once over USB so the running firmware accepts over-the-air updates. This issue clears once the YAML is read again.

refresh_policy.title: Git Sources of {title} may be built from a stale cached clone
refresh_policy.description:
These Git Sources of {title} lack `refresh: always`: {sources}. ESPHome reuses its cached clone of a Git Source until its refresh time runs out (1 day by default), so an Install could build an old commit while recording the new one. ESPHome Git Updates refuses to install {title} until each of them sets `refresh: always` (or `0s`), for example:

```yaml
external_components:
  - source: github://owner/repo
    refresh: always
```

Remote `packages:` take `refresh: always` too; a `github://` shorthand package cannot, so write it as a mapping with `url:`, `ref:`, `files:` and `refresh: always`. This issue clears once the YAML is read again.

include_refused.title: Device Builder refused to read a file of {title}
include_refused.description: {title} includes {file}, but the Device Builder refused to read it ({error}). Without it, ESPHome Git Updates cannot see every Git Source of {title}, so their updates are not refreshed. This usually means the Device Builder now restricts which files can be read. If {file} was removed or renamed, fix the include in the YAML.
